files.description: Basic filled and stroked path primitives.
files.expected: A red rectangle, a blue triangle, and a thick green cubic curve on white.

files.description: A translated path with the CTM set before path construction.
files.expected: A red trapezoid has bottom vertices (30,50), (110,50) and top vertices (210,180), (30,180); the translation applies to the entire path.

files.description: Clipping set inside q/Q and restored afterward.
files.expected: A red diamond on the left and a separate blue rectangle to its right; the blue rectangle remains entirely visible after Q.

files.description: Nested clips with an even-odd hole and restoration of the inner clip.
files.expected: A red left half of a rectangular ring and a blue right half; the center hole and everything outside the outer rectangle remain white.

files.description: The v cubic shorthand immediately follows closepath.
files.expected: A dark triangular outline with a curved lobe rising from its starting point; the curve begins at the point restored by h.

files.description: Text alternates with opaque painting, including path clipping.
files.expected: The red bar hides the middle of the large black BACK text; blue FRONT text is drawn above it. Green CLIPPED text is visible only inside the narrow rectangular clip.

files.description: A page whose MediaBox has a nonzero lower-left corner.
files.expected: A 240 by 160 page with a red rectangle inset 20 points from its lower-left corner and a blue rectangle inset 20 points from its upper-right corner.

files.description: CropBox selects an offset subrectangle of a larger MediaBox.
files.expected: The visible page is 200 by 140 points: a green rectangle sits inside it, while a red rectangle outside the CropBox is not visible.

files.description: Page rotation inherited from its Pages parent.
files.expected: A landscape page is displayed as portrait, rotated clockwise 90 degrees; the red lower-left and blue upper-right markers move with the page.

files.description: Text matrix rotation, text rise, horizontal scaling and character/word spacing.
files.expected: A diagonal ROTATED label, a BASE label with a raised UP, and a wide-spaced, horizontally compressed A B C line.

files.description: Fill, stroke, fill-and-stroke, invisible, and text-as-clip rendering modes.
files.expected: Top row shows black filled FILL, outlined STROKE and red-filled blue-outlined BOTH. INVISIBLE is absent; the bottom shows a green rectangle only inside large CLIP glyphs.

files.description: A Form XObject with its own shear matrix and bounding-box clip, drawn twice.
files.expected: Two sheared blue frames enclosing white and red rectangles; the oversized blue form content is clipped to each form's transformed bounding box.

files.description: One-, two-, and four-bit grayscale images with padded rows and Decode arrays.
files.expected: Three enlarged two-row, five-column grayscale grids. The 1-bit grid alternates black and white; the 2-bit grid has four levels; the 4-bit grid has five levels reversed by Decode.

files.description: A one-bit image mask painted with the current fill color.
files.expected: A large red pixelated square-ring pattern over a pale blue background, with the background visible through unpainted mask pixels.

files.description: An RGB image with a grayscale soft mask of four alpha levels.
files.expected: Four red image columns over a blue rectangle transition from fully transparent blue through two blended purples to opaque red.

files.description: Nonstroking alpha applied to overlapping opaque-colored rectangles.
files.expected: A half-transparent red rectangle and a half-transparent blue rectangle overlap on white; their overlap is darker and purple, with blue composited on top.

files.description: An axial shading with a type 2 interpolation function.
files.expected: A broad horizontal gradient inside a rectangle changes smoothly from red on the left to blue on the right, with white outside.

files.description: CCITT one-dimensional Group 3 and two-dimensional Group 4 image streams.
files.expected: Two bordered panels have black top halves and white bottom halves, labelled G3 and G4.

files.description: All sixteen PDF blend modes with partial source alpha.
files.expected: A labelled 4x4 grid blends orange over cyan using each named mode; the overlap differs by mode and q/Q prevents state leaking into the next panel.

files.description: Isolated/non-isolated groups with and without knockout over an opaque blue backdrop.
files.expected: Four labelled panels apply group opacity once. Isolated groups retain red/green; non-isolated Multiply uses the blue backdrop. Knockout removes the first member under the second member's shape.

files.description: ExtGState alpha and luminosity masks from the same colored transparent form.
files.expected: The Alpha panel has uniform half-opacity orange over blue. Luminosity is weaker on the red-mask left half than on the white-mask right half. Blue outside each masked rectangle remains unchanged.

files.description: Inherited mixed-width CMap with explicit W2 and DW2 metrics.
files.expected: A, B, C and D descend vertically, with unequal advances and horizontal offsets from W2; the child CMap overrides its parent CID mapping.

files.description: Vertical CID text with implicit DW2 metrics for the final glyph.
files.expected: The first three glyphs match vertical-cid; D uses the default vertical origin and 1000-unit downward advance.

files.description: Linear Gray ICC conversion shared by image, fill, stroke and shading.
files.expected: The three top paints are the same light gray (near RGB 188), not device gray 128; the lower gradient has a light, not dark, midpoint.

files.description: RGB ICC matrix/TRC profile with red and green primaries exchanged.
files.expected: All three top paints are green despite red source samples; the gradient runs green to red.

files.description: CMYK ICC lut8 profile mapping increasing K from Lab black to white.
files.expected: The three top paints are mid-gray near RGB 119; the gradient runs black to white, opposite naive CMYK K.

files.description: CMYK ICC legacy lut16 Lab encoding with slightly tinted neutral components.
files.expected: The top paints agree near mid-gray with a small warm tint; the gradient runs black to near-white using legacy 0xff00 L encoding.

files.description: ICCBased Range bounds values without renormalizing them; explicit Decode reverses image samples.
files.expected: The default image and 0.2 vector paint use the lower valid component; reversed Decode and the 0.8 vector paint match lighter gray. Poppler may ignore Range for default image Decode; the PDF default is the declared Range.

files.description: Type 1 shading driven by a two-input sampled RGB function.
files.expected: An 80 by 80 square inset 10 points transitions from black at lower-left to red at lower-right, green at upper-left and yellow at upper-right; the surrounding border is white.

files.description: The same two-dimensional shading evaluated by a calculator function returning x, y and zero.
files.expected: The square and white border match function-sampled-2d, including all interior colors.

files.description: A calculator axial gradient chooses different RGB output expressions on either side of its midpoint.
files.expected: Inside the clipped panel the left half runs black to red; the right half starts cyan and runs to blue, with a sharp red-to-cyan boundary at x=160. Outside the panel is white.

files.description: Five hundred individually numbered pages for scrolling, zoom and worker lifecycle checks.
files.expected: Each 320 by 240 page has its own Page NNNN label and a large blue rectangle on odd pages or red rectangle on even pages. Page 0500 is red; navigating back to Page 0001 restores blue.

files.description: Direct painting above and a nested non-isolated Form below use Difference over painted and initially transparent parts of an isolated page.
files.expected: The entire left half is magenta (blue Difference red); the entire right half is blue, not yellow from the external white background. The direct upper half and nested Form lower half must match.

files.description: Positive 0.3-unit strokes and zero-width hairlines under a 0.35 scale transform.
files.expected: Two labelled panels of horizontal black lines. Subpixel lines on the left have much less coverage than the one-device-pixel hairlines on the right; positive widths must not be promoted to hairlines.

files.description: Linear RGB page blending shared by vector, image, shading and tiling-pattern paints.
files.expected: All four quadrants are the same bright purple near RGB (188,0,188), not sRGB-space (128,0,128). Red and half-alpha blue are blended before display conversion.

files.description: Adobe RGB page blends green with quarter-alpha red without clipping source paints to sRGB first.
files.expected: All four quadrants agree near RGB (0,193,0), with no red contamination. The independent oracle converts the final Adobe RGB components (0.25,0.75,0), not separately clipped source colors.

files.description: Linear RGB isolated and non-isolated Forms return their source contribution to an sRGB parent before boundary opacity and Multiply.
files.expected: Top quadrants both show bright purple near (188,0,188). Bottom-left is near (94,128,94): half that display-space purple over green. Bottom-right is near (0,128,0): half-opacity Multiply over green. Untouched parent pixels must not make a profile roundtrip.

files.description: Bidirectional RGB lut8 XYZ page space, with four source paint types composited as encoded components.
files.expected: At (50,50), (150,50), (50,150), (150,150) all four source paints produce the LittleCMS color of encoded RGB (0.5,0,0.5), not half the separately displayed red and blue.

files.description: RGB lut16 Lab Form with same-space nested group, distinct RGB lut8 XYZ nested group, non-isolated backdrop, and opacity/blend/mask boundaries.
files.expected: Top-left (50,50) is LittleCMS Lab L*75 near (186,184,183): same-space nested Form must not roundtrip through non-reciprocal B2A. Top-right (150,50) is half-alpha Lab white over green near (128,255,127); bottom-left (50,150) is near (93,220,92) after half-opacity over green; bottom-right (150,150) converts half-blue XYZ into Lab before half-opacity Multiply and a half-alpha mask, near (0,207,0).

files.description: RGB LUT luminosity mask preserves encoded source components before XYZ Y extraction and transfer.
files.expected: The profile maps encoded red 0.5 to XYZ Y 0.25: left red over white is (255,191,191), and inverse transfer on the right gives (255,64,64). A lossy B2A roundtrip must not alter mask luminosity.

files.description: Order 3 four-knot grayscale interpolation with Decode headroom for cubic overshoot.
files.expected: A grayscale hill from black through the 0.8-valued inner knots, peaking near 0.9 (RGB 230) at the center. Linear interpolation incorrectly gives a flat 0.8 plateau. Uses uniform Catmull-Rom with secant endpoint tangents.

files.description: Tensor-product sampled function with cubic four-knot x and linear two-knot y.
files.expected: Inside an inset square, red rises from zero at both sides to about 230 in the middle, while green rises linearly from bottom to top. The center is near RGB (230,128,0). Samples advance along x first.

files.description: Wide-gamut inherited fill provenance, nested nonisolated linear group and boundary alpha mask plus opacity.
files.expected: Top quadrants match near (0,192,0): inherited Adobe green must not be recovered from clipped sRGB. Bottom-left nested linear groups produce (188,0,188). Bottom-right applies half mask and half opacity exactly once over green, near (47,191,47).

files.description: Adobe RGB luminosity masks composite encoded components before conversion to XYZ Y.
files.expected: Top-left opaque half-gray, top-right isolated half-black over white BC, and bottom-left nonisolated half-black over white BC all yield pale red near (255,200,200), not (255,128,128). Bottom-right inverts the luminosity through TR and is near (255,55,55).

files.description: Isolated/nonisolated Multiply inside a bounded ICC luminosity mask over red BC, with and without inverse TR.
files.expected: Every quadrant has a 60-point inner square. Top-left center is near (255,239,239), top-right center white; both outside rings are near (255,176,176). Bottom-left center is near (255,16,16), bottom-right center red; both rings are near (255,79,79). BC and TR apply outside BBox too.

files.description: CMYK lut8 Lab source paints inside an Adobe RGB page blending space.
files.expected: All four quadrants agree: neutral half-K source at 75 percent opacity over Adobe red. The fourth source component drives Lab lightness; vector, image, shading and pattern must use the same PCS conversion.

files.description: CMYK legacy lut16 Lab source paints inside an Adobe RGB page blending space.
files.expected: All four quadrants agree, with the profile's slight warm Lab tint retained before Adobe-space compositing over red.

files.description: CMYK lut8 XYZ wide-gamut source paints inside an Adobe RGB page.
files.expected: All four quadrants agree: half-K attenuated Adobe green at 75 percent opacity over red. Source XYZ must not roundtrip through clipped sRGB before blending; independent profile-to-profile conversion supplies the color oracle.

files.description: CMYK lut16 XYZ wide-gamut source paints inside an Adobe RGB page.
files.expected: All four quadrants agree with the higher precision version of lut8-xyz-managed-source, preserving out-of-sRGB gamut coordinates and the fourth input component.

files.description: A rectangular clip intersects a diamond clip across consecutive fills and a third shading clip; Q restores each parent.
files.expected: A red-left/green-right diamond clipped to an inset square contains a cyan central region. A later blue bar spans the outer clip's top even outside the diamond; the final magenta strip lies outside all prior clips. Corners excluded by the diamond remain white.

files.description: Five rows of fill, stroke, shading, tiling pattern and Type3 glyph paints; columns alternate opacity/shape alpha in isolated then nonisolated knockout groups.
files.expected: Each interior overlap is cyan (0,128,127) in opacity columns and purple (128,0,127) in shape columns. AIS true preserves half the preceding red; AIS false knocks red out. Stroke coverage is confined to its central band. Indirect true AIS values must be resolved.

files.description: Alpha, luminosity and inverse-alpha mask rows distinguish mask shape from opacity, including outside the mask BBox.
files.expected: On each panel's left half, opacity columns are near (0,191,64) and shape columns (191,0,64). Outside the mask BBox, top two rows are green for opacity and red for shape. The inverse-transfer bottom row instead gives cyan/purple half-alpha outside the BBox.

files.description: Nested color-managed Forms distinguish internal opacity from internal shape and outer AIS. Rows alternate isolated/nonisolated parents, then repeat with Difference at the nested boundary.
files.expected: Within painted shape, first three rows have column RGB near (0,223,32), (128,96,32), (223,0,32), (128,128,0). Nonisolated Difference bottom row gives (0,255,32), (128,128,32), (223,32,32), (128,128,0). The rightmost strip inside each Form BBox remains red: BBox is not object shape. Transparent intrinsic opacity must not become zero shape.

files.description: Image SMask and color-key masks override a zero graphics-state mask; stencil and inline images obey a half graphics-state mask; JPX embedded alpha overrides conflicting masks.
files.expected: Soft-mask row: opacity panels have green left and quarter-blue cyan right; shape panels retain red left and quarter-blue purple right. Color-key row: red left in all columns, cyan/purple right. Stencil row: quarter-blue cyan/purple left and red right. Inline-image row is uniformly quarter-blue cyan/purple. JPX row matches the first row despite its zero SMask, all-masking color key and zero graphics-state mask.
